_comment: Bash commands from docsync E2E runs and their mutations. {repo} is the fixture repo, {other} a directory outside it, {home} the fixture home. known_good: read-only forms the observer must accept. known_bad: forms it must keep rejecting. known_bad also keeps genuine model misses from PR gate runs as negative controls: the composed cat; cat of ship-docsync-failure 38984977679 (bash#12). The Bash grep of ship-docsync-missing-asset 38983306684 (bash#13) is a pure read inside the fixture home, so the shared read-only grammar (GSTA-49) accepts it in known_good_posix (the grammar resolves POSIX paths only and accepts nothing on Windows), as it does the Opus slips wc -l (39173752116) and ls with a glob (effort study t10); its tee, outside-path, recursive-credential and denied-glob mutations stay in known_bad.
